categories.main_business_segments: Beijing ABT Networks Co., Ltd. focuses on network security core software products, including security gateways, security management, full traffic security, data security, cloud security, and security services. The company also develops AI security products and solutions, integrating AI with network security and computing power. It serves as a provider of core systems, products, and security services in the network security industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary technologies such as the ABT SPOS network security system platform, hardware-agnostic technology, multi-core parallel security operating systems, network behavior profiling, and security policy data mining. It develops embedded and virtualized security gateways, AI-powered security models, and heterogeneous computing orchestration platforms. Production includes software-only and software-hardware integrated products, with hardware procured from suppliers and software embedded and tested internally.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government departments, central enterprises, telecom operators, cloud service providers, and large solution integrators. The company serves industries such as telecommunications, finance, energy, and government sectors. Major customers include Huawei, New H3C, Anheng Information, AsiaInfo Security, and others. The company also targets emerging markets like AI infrastructure and low-altitude economy security.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries in Wuhan, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and other cities. It has expanded overseas through wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, conducting procurement and sales of information and communication infrastructure modules. The geographic coverage includes key Chinese regions such as North China, East China, South China, and Southwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: ABT Networks operates mainly in the upstream segment of the network security industry chain, focusing on core system software and technology provision. It supplies network security capabilities and software platforms to midstream product and solution vendors. The company procures hardware components from suppliers but develops and integrates core software and security technologies internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI-driven network security, integrating AI, computing power, and security technologies to build an AI-era secure computing ecosystem. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI security models, heterogeneous computing orchestration, zero-trust security, data security, cloud security, and security operation automation. The strategic direction includes expanding AI+security product lines, enhancing product intelligence, and deepening industry-specific applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of network security products (software and hardware-integrated), security services including technical development and operation maintenance, and AI security solutions. The company also earns income from long-term contracts for computing center planning, construction, and joint operations. Licensing and government subsidies contribute to other income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ABT Networks is recognized as a leading upstream network security technology provider in China, ranked among the top 20 network security companies nationally. It holds multiple national certifications and awards, including CMMI Level 5 and national specialized 'Little Giant' enterprise status. The company competes with major domestic network security firms and is noted for its strong R&D and AI integration capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 736.75 million, a 34.37% increase year-over-year. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 118.67 million due to increased credit impairment losses and investment in new business areas. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.78 billion and net assets of RMB 1.12 billion, with sustained high R&D investment accounting for over 21% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ABT Networks emphasizes its proprietary ABT SPOS platform and hardware-agnostic technology, enabling rapid adaptation across diverse hardware architectures. Its products integrate AI capabilities for intelligent threat detection, automated security operations, and comprehensive data asset monitoring. The company offers a unified security resource pool and flexible security service chain orchestration, providing customers with scalable, reliable, and intelligent network security solutions tailored to complex and evolving digital environments.
